title: San Pedro Waterfront Gives Locals First Look at Massive West Harbor
description:
Soccer fans and local families got an exciting sneak peek at San Pedro’s new West Harbor project ahead of its official opening this fall. The redeveloped Port of Los Angeles Waterfront recently hosted the official World Cup LA Fan Zone, bringing neighbors together for live match broadcasts, local bites, and stunning ocean views.

Visitors enjoyed early tastes from upcoming dining spots like LoZio Pizza and The Baked Bear. The lively event transformed the former Ports O’ Call site into a safe, upbeat gathering space for all Angelenos.
Once completed, the new waterfront attraction will feature a mile-long promenade, harbor cruises, children's play areas, and a massive ferris wheel. Local residents say sharing these energetic moments with friends and family proves just how deeply sports and community spaces can unite people.
